title: Mikey Amore - New Heights
htmlContent:
Mikey Amore's "New Heights" is undeniable audio brilliance. He shoots for the stars and aims for the moon on this one-of-a-kind record, that blends so many things together, to make one amazing record that you can listen to over and over again. He sings with so much soul, that you wonder how he knows you need to hear this song, at this moment. The production embodies a vibe that made the sound famous, with amazing songwriting that tells this story to perfection to make everything come together righteously.
